{{Top|leg}}
A '''kamen''' was the smallest military division within the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] military structure known as the [[Kolkpravis]] although they predated the military organization on [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]. A single kamen could consist of between two and forty Kaleesh tribal [[Soldier|warriors]] the strongest of whom would lead the kamen under the informal title of [[blackarm]]. A hundred kamen made up a [[horde]] which was led by a [[Tarkhan]].<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
